about.heading: An Academic Reference Built for Curious Botanists and Growers
paragraphs: Plantipedia transforms botanical reference literature into a structured, high-contrast digital museum. Every entry pairs classical taxonomic rigor—from family lineage and floral morphology to pollination syndromes—with practical agronomic guidance rooted in South Asian, tropical, and global growing traditions.

Curated cleanly across 50 documented plant species with 15 Botanical Chapters per Plant and connected via a zero-key uplink to a 400,000+ Global Flora & Tree Collection, the archive delivers context-matched monographs backed by verified photography, bilingual EN / বাংলা nomenclature, and print-ready field sheets.

globalGateway.statusTag: ZERO-KEY LIVE UPLINK · STRICT LOCAL BYPASS
globalGateway.heading: Worldwide Botanical Server Gateway
paragraphs: While Plantipedia's core archive houses 50 deeply curated, 15-chapter botanical monographs, the global plant kingdom spans more than 400,000+ documented vascular plants and tree species. This dedicated gateway connects your research session directly to the Global Botanical Server for live taxonomic, morphological, and bilingual records.

Every query entered in this console bypasses the local 50-species index entirely—synthesizing real-time global botanical dossiers on demand with automated plant validation, English and বাংলা nomenclature cross-referencing, and instant split-screen comparison readiness.

nextMilestone.heading: Next Up: Version 3.2 — Multi-Source Parallel Botanical Engine
nextMilestone.description: Immediately following Plantipedia Version 3.1, the upcoming Version 3.2 release upgrades live querying into a parallel multi-source botanical engine uniting GBIF, Global Flora Index, Wikidata, and iNaturalist—complete with a multi-angle specimen image aggregator and typo-tolerant fuzzy search mapped to the global '/' shortcut.

pillars.title: GBIF + Global Flora Index + Wikidata + iNaturalist
pillars.description: Concurrent cross-database resolution harmonizes verified Linnaean binomials, occurrence distributions, IUCN conservation tiers, and multilingual common names without single-source blind spots.

pillars.title: Herbarium & Field Specimen Carousel
pillars.description: Dynamic imagery pipelines assemble verified canopy silhouettes, floral macro studies, bark textures, and fruiting habits from open botanical repositories.

pillars.title: Typo-Tolerant Search & '/' Shortcut
